annotations.title: Scope 3 Spend-Based EEIO Supply Chain Carbon Screener

description:
[Scope 3 spend-based EEIO supply chain carbon screener. Deterministic calculation, read-only, side-effect free]. Estimates Scope 3 Category 1/2 supply chain emissions per euro spent mapped to Eurostat/EXIOBASE NACE Rev. 2 economic sectors, providing CSRD ESRS E1 Tier 3 screening baselines.
Usage: Use this tool to quickly calculate carbon intensity from procurement accounting ledgers when primary supplier activity data is unavailable.
Returns: JSON object with { spendAmountEur: number, naceSectorCode: string, naceSectorTitle: string, spendEmissionIntensityKgCo2ePerEur: number, calculatedEmissions: object, dataQualityTier: string }.

isCapitalExpenditureCapex.description: True if spend is CapEx (Scope 3 Category 2 Capital goods) rather than OpEx (Category 1)

naceSectorCode.description: 2-digit or 3-digit NACE Rev. 2 sector code (e.g. J62 Software, C20 Chemicals, C24 Basic Metals, M69 Legal/Accounting)

spendAmountEur.description: Total invoice expenditure or procurement spend in EUR

name: scope3_spend_based_eeio_calculator
